[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (a b: Int) : Int :=
if a = 0 then b
else if b = 0 then a
else
  let r := a % b
  implementation b r
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma mod_divisor
(a b: Int)
(r: Int)
(h_mod: a % b = r)
(h_div_a: ∃ d, a = b * d + r)
(h_div_b: ∃ d, b = a * d + r)
: b ∣ r :=
by
cases h_div_a with d₁
cases h_div_b with d₂
have h_r_eq: r = a - b * d₁ := by
  simp [h_mod, Int.sub_add_cancel]
have h_b_div_r: b ∣ a - b * d₁ := by
  simp [h_r_eq]
exact h_b_div_r
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation a b
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_a_eq_0: a = 0 → result ∣ a ∧ result ∣ b ∧ result ≥ 0 ∧
  (∀ d', d' ∣ a → d' ∣ b → d' ∣ result) := by
  intros h_a_0
  simp [h_a_0]
  apply And.intro
  exact Nat.cast_nonneg 0
  apply And.intro
  intros d' h_d'_a h_d'_b
  simp [h_d'_a, h_d'_b]
  apply Nat.cast_nonpos
  simp [h_a_0]
have h_b_eq_0: b = 0 → result ∣ a ∧ result ∣ b ∧ result ≥ 0 ∧
  (∀ d', d' ∣ a → d' ∣ b → d' ∣ result) := by
  intros h_b_0
  simp [h_b_0]
  apply And.intro
  exact Nat.cast_nonneg 0
  apply And.intro
  intros d' h_d'_a h_d'_b
  simp [h_d'_a, h_d'_b]
  apply Nat.cast_nonpos
  simp [h_b_0]
have h_a_ne_0_b_ne_0: a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  cases h with h_a_0 h_b_0
  exact h_a_0
  exact h_b_0
have h_a_ne_0: a ≠ 0 := by
  cases h_a_ne_0_b_ne_0 with h_a_0 h_b_0
  exact h_a_0
have h_b_ne_0: b ≠ 0 := by
  cases h_a_ne_0_b_ne_0 with h_a_0 h_b_0
  exact h_b_0
have h_a_eq_b: a = b → result ∣ a ∧ result ∣ b ∧ result ≥ 0 ∧
  (∀ d', d' ∣ a → d' ∣ b → d' ∣ result) := by
  intros h_a_b
  simp [h_a_b]
  apply And.intro
  exact Nat.cast_nonneg b
  apply And.intro
  intros d' h_d'_a h_d'_b
  simp [h_d'_a, h_d'_b]
  apply Nat.cast_nonpos
  simp [h_a_b]
have h_a_ne_b: a ≠ b → result ∣ a ∧ result ∣ b ∧ result ≥ 0 ∧
  (∀ d', d' ∣ a → d' ∣ b → d' ∣ result) := by
  intros h_a_ne_b
  have h_result_eq_a: result = a := by
    simp [h_a_ne_b, h_b_ne_0, h_a_ne_0]
  apply And.intro
  simp [h_result_eq_a]
  apply And.intro
  intros d' h_d'_a h_d'_b
  simp [h_d'_a, h_d'_b, h_result_eq_a]
  apply Nat.cast_nonpos
  simp [h_result_eq_a]
have h_a_ne_b': a ≠ b → result ∣ a ∧ result ∣ b ∧ result ≥ 0 ∧
  (∀ d', d' ∣ a → d' ∣ b → d' ∣ result) := by
  intros h_a_ne_b
  have h_result_eq_b: result = b := by
    simp [h_a_ne_b, h_a_ne_0, h_b_ne_0]
  apply And.intro
  simp [h_result_eq_b]
  apply And.intro
  intros d' h_d'_a h_d'_b
  simp [h_d'_a, h_d'_b, h_result_eq_b]
  apply Nat.cast_nonpos
  simp [h_result_eq_b]
have h_a_ne_0_b_ne_0_a_ne_b: a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ b → result ∣ a ∧ result ∣ b ∧ result ≥ 0 ∧
  (∀ d', d' ∣ a → d' ∣ b → d' ∣ result) := by
  intros h_a_ne_0_b_ne_0_a_ne_b
  have h_result_eq_gcd: result = implementation b (a % b) := by
    simp [h_a_ne_0_b_ne_0_a_ne_b, h_a_ne_0, h_b_ne_0]
  apply And.intro
  simp [h_result_eq_gcd]
  apply And.intro
  intros d' h_d'_a h_d'_b
  simp [h_d'_a, h_d'_b, h_result_eq_gcd]
  apply Nat.cast_nonpos
  simp [h_result_eq_gcd]
[END]
